## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Solved / Learning Need
Is your feature request related to a specific computer science learning hurdle? (e.g., "Students struggle to visualize how virtual memory pages map to physical frames.")

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see, including potential interactive controls or visual elements.

## Alternative Approaches Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Pedagogical Impact
How does this feature enhance understanding for university students or self-taught developers?
